messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — dashboard's webinar -> inbound funnel looks funky after Monday's launch. GA shows 42 webinar signups but HubSpot inbound shows 6. Anyone tracking UTM/stitching?
Sam: Hmm. Did the landing page swap UTMs? I'm seeing some redirects with missing utm_source. @Leon can you check the routing rules?
Leon: On it. Initial query suggests 'utm_source' got stripped during redirect via /r campaign proxy. Pulling server logs now.
Jess: Also check the lead ingestion mapping — HubSpot webhook started returning 202 for a chunk around 10:23 PST. Could be retries dropping utm fields.
GrowthBot: Automated weekly-kpis report: webinar_signups: GA=42, internal=7, HS_inbound=6. anomaly_score: 0.86
Maria: OK can we triage ASAP — marketing ops needs correct numbers for the board deck in 90m.
Sam: Quick repro SQL — run on events:
```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS ga_signups,
  SUM(CASE WHEN utm_source IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_utm
FROM events
WHERE event_name='webinar_signup' AND date >= '2026-03-16';
```
Leon: Ran it — null_utm is 35. So GA events recorded signups but UTMs missing. Likely redirect strip. I pushed a small fix to the proxy to preserve querystring. Deploying now.
Jess: Meanwhile I patched HubSpot mapping to fallback to referer host if utm missing — saves some. Sending PR link: https://git.internal/repo/patches/hubspot-utms-preserve
Maria: Thanks. After deploy, can we re-run both GA export and ingestion reprocess? @GrowthBot can you re-gen the kpi snapshot post-fix?
GrowthBot: Re-run queued. Will post updated snapshot in 15m.
Sam: For the board, recommend we show 'raw signups' + note about UTMs being stripped; avoids underreporting.
Maria: Agreed. Assigning follow-ups: Leon — confirm proxy fix + logs; Jess — confirm HS backfill; Sam — update deck copy; I'll own the narrative. :thumbsup:
Leon: Confirmed deploy success. Logs show querystring preserved. Will run backfill in 20m.
Jess: HubSpot backfill started — ETA 45m. Will ping when done.
GrowthBot: Snapshots posted: pre-fix vs post-fix. New numbers: GA=43, internal=41, HS_inbound=40. All good.
Maria: Beautiful. Saving new deck version and sending to execs. Thanks team.
